additional_info.body:
Hello Christian, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
We have this report from RC-FI that shows a dispenser welding problem on the door switch. I send all the photos and video in attachment.
A report from a few months back is that, the RC already faced a related issue with the door where it wasn't opening and he had to break the cable holder to open the door, in a way to not break anything else. See also a photo from this incident in attach (kuva.png)
Please let me know what should be done because now the RC would need to buy a welding machine just to fix this particular issue.
Information regarding this dispenser:
Outcome of wiring checkup:
Door sensor is working fine → no need to replace
Locking mechanism is not okay
Commissioning date:
12/07/2023
Date of failure
(see side note)
Please let me know if you need anything else.
Best regards,
Francisco
